visualCharacteristics: A full-viewport hero with a fixed looping background video and a white serif title and subtitle at the bottom left that fade in once.
contentPattern: Row 1: an h1 whose em holds the title line and the following text the subtitle line. Row 2: two cells with links to the landscape video and the portrait video files.
usage: Use it as the opening key visual of a recruitment page with a full-screen background video.
reuseGuidance: Reuse it for video-backed full-screen page openers; use the standard hero for image-based heroes.
